name: mcal_list_events
description: List events in one calendar (by `calendar` slug), soonest first. For a single day PREFER `day` — pass `today`, `tomorrow`, `yesterday`, or a `YYYY-MM-DD` date and the server resolves it in THIS calendar's own timezone (so you never do UTC date math). Alternatively give explicit `from`/`to` bounds (UTC ISO-8601, e.g. 2026-07-28T00:00:00Z) for arbitrary ranges; `day` overrides from/to. Omit all three to list everything. Each event has: id (UUID), title, description, location, starts_at, ends_at (UTC ISO-8601 — convert to the calendar's timezone when reporting), all_day, source ('portal'|'google'), status. Use this to find an event's `id` before mcal_get_event / mcal_update_event / mcal_delete_event.

day.description: Optional single day, resolved in the calendar's timezone: 'today', 'tomorrow', 'yesterday', or 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Preferred for day questions; overrides from/to. Omit for none.

from.description: Optional lower bound on the window, UTC ISO-8601. Omit for none.

to.description: Optional upper bound on the window, UTC ISO-8601. Omit for none.
